# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{"name": "bash", "description": "Run a shell command.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"command": {"type": "string", "description": "Command"}}, "required": ["command"]}}
{"name": "text_editor", "description": "View or edit files.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"command": {"type": "string"}, "path": {"type": "string"}, "view_range": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "integer"}}}, "required": ["command", "path"]}}
</tools>

    raise NotImplementedError</tool_response><|assistant|><think>Now run the tests.</think><tool_call>bash<arg_key>command</arg_key><arg_value>python test.py</arg_value></tool_call><|observation|><tool_response>AssertionError</tool_response><|assistant|><think>
